Copy of F.I.R. 326/39.
Hongkew,
9/5/39.

Forwarded for classification.

Sir,

At 11 noon 9/5/39, one named J.Laurence, Ceylonese,
residing 165 Broadway (Chinese shop and dwelling house) came
to the station and reported larceny of $50.00 from his room.
The complainant suspects that money had been taken by
one named Corbin known by nick name "Dick" British, age about
25, height about 5' 1", blond hair brushed back, wearing dark
brown woollen suit, no hat. The complainant stated that he is
merchant by profession and arrived to Shanghai about 5 months ago.
During his stay in Shanghai he frequented the Navy Y.M.C.A.
on Szechuen Road where on or about 10/4/39, he met Corbin. Since
that time they met each other nearly every day and on several
occasions the complainant helped Corbin with money to the total
amount of $25.00.
In the evening of 8/5/39, the complainant took Corbin to
the Russian restaurant on Nange Road for dinner and during
conversation discovered that Corbin had no place to sleep. The
complainant offered to Corbin shelter in his room to which Corbin
agreed and they went to 165 Broadway. Before retiring to beds,
the complainant had mentioned to Corbin that there was a sum of
$50.00 in his jacket pocket.
At about 8.30 a.m. the following day the complainant woke
up and saw Corbin dressed and ready to go out. The complainant
asked Corbin to wait for him on which later said that he was
going to Navy Y.M.C.A. where he will wait for him (complainant).
About one hour later the complainant on examining his
pockets, discovered that the money had disappeared. He went to
the Navy Y.M.C.A. but Corbin was not there. The complainant's
room is secured with a "Yale" lock and there was no possibility
for anyone else to enter the room during the night and steal the
money.
Intention of the complainant by reporting the matter is to
recover his money, but he definitely refuses to proceed with
a charge against Corbin.
The case respectfully forwarded for classification.

第 326/39 号 FIR（报案记录）副本。
虹口，
1939年5月9日。

呈送以作分类归档。

先生：

1939年5月9日上午11时，一名名为 J. Laurence 的锡兰人，居住于百老汇路165号（中国商铺及住宅），来到警局报案，称其房间内被盗50.00美元。报案人怀疑钱财系一名绰号“Dick”的英国人 Corbin 所窃，该人约25岁，身高约5英尺1英寸，金发向后梳理，身穿深棕色羊毛西装，未戴帽子。报案人称其职业为商人，约5个月前抵达上海。在上海逗留期间，他常去四川路的海军青年会（Navy Y.M.C.A.），并于1939年4月10日左右在那里结识了 Corbin。此后他们几乎每天见面，报案人曾多次资助 Corbin，总金额达25.00美元。

1939年5月8日晚，报案人带 Corbin 去南格路（Nange Road）的一家俄罗斯餐馆吃晚饭，交谈中发现 Corbin 无处过夜。报案人提议让 Corbin 在其房间借宿，Corbin 表示同意，两人遂前往百老汇路165号。睡前，报案人曾告诉 Corbin，其夹克口袋里有50.00美元。

次日上午约8时30分，报案人醒来，看见 Corbin 已穿好衣服准备外出。报案人让 Corbin 等他，Corbin 后来说他将去海军青年会那里等报案人。约一小时后，报案人检查口袋时发现钱已不翼而飞。他前往海军青年会，但 Corbin 不在那里。报案人的房间装有“耶鲁”牌锁，夜间其他人不可能进入房间行窃。

报案人报案的目的是追回失款，但他明确拒绝对 Corbin 提起指控。

本案谨此呈送以作分类归档。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
                                ............Station,
            REPORT              Date December 15, 1938.
Subject Joseph Andrew Lawrence - applicant for employment with the
        Shanghai Municipal Council.
Made by D.S. Hide               Forwarded by C Crawford

Joseph Andrew Lawrence, applicant for employment
with the Shanghai Municipal Council, was born in Kandy,
Ceylon, on March 10th, 1897. His father Martin Lawrence,
a Portuguese of British nationality, was an engineer in the
employ of the Ceylon Government Railways. His mother
Bridget Terryn, was born in the Netherlands.

Lawrence was educated at St. Benedict's College
in Kandy where he was successful in passing the junior and
senior Cambridge examinations.

In 1914 he obtained a three year contract with
Messrs Harrisons & Crossfield, a firm of tea merchants in
Ceylon and was appointed private secretary to Mr. J.F.
Darby, the former proprietor of their recently purchased
subsidiary concern of Darby & Co., General Merchants of
Sandakan in British North Borneo. During his employment
in this capacity, Lawrence became proficient in shorthand,
typewriting, accountancy, de-coding and general office
routine.

Following the expiration of his contract with
Harrisons and Crossfields, Lawrence proceeded to Hongkong
where, in 1920, he obtained an appointment as private sec-
retary to Sir John Jameson then British Consul-General
in Shmeen which post he lost about five months later
when a Mr. Wallace returned from leave.

Lawrence then came to Shanghai where he became
associated with Edward Ezra and other Jewish members of the
Stock Exchange. By means of forward Sterling purchases
and stock gambling in general, he quickly amassed a fortune

制作人 D.S. Hide               转呈人 C Crawford

Joseph Andrew Lawrence，申请受雇于上海公共租界工部局者，于1897年3月10日出生于锡兰康提（Kandy）。其父 Martin Lawrence 为拥有英国国籍的葡萄牙人，曾任锡兰政府铁路工程师。其母 Bridget Terryn 出生于荷兰。

Lawrence 就读于康提的圣本笃学院（St. Benedict's College），并成功通过了剑桥初级和高级考试。

1914年，他与锡兰茶商 Harrisons & Crossfield 公司签订了一份为期三年的合同，并被任命为 J.F. Darby 先生的私人秘书。Darby 先生是其公司最近收购的子公司——位于英属北婆罗洲山打根（Sandakan）的 Darby & Co. 百货商行——的前所有者。在此期间，Lawrence 熟练掌握了速记、打字、会计、解码及一般办公室日常事务。

在与 Harrisons and Crossfields 的合同期满后，Lawrence 前往香港，并于1920年获得任命，担任时任驻厦门（Shmeen）英国总领事 John Jameson 爵士的私人秘书，但该职位在五个月后因一位 Wallace 先生休假归来而丢失。

随后 Lawrence 来到上海，与 Edward Ezra 及其他犹太籍证券交易所成员建立联系。通过远期英镑购买和一般的股票投机，他迅速积累了财富

operating in Dairen.    Conditions were such that by 1938
Lawrence's business failed and he was rendered penniless.
    In June he proceeded to Peking where he made a
detailed report to the British Embassy regarding conditions
in Manchukuo.    Through Capt. Hill of the British Embassy
he endeavoured to secure an appointment as Japanese
interpreter to the British Consulate in Hongkong but his
application was refused when the British Authorities learned
that he is a friend of Mr. George W. Goldman, Editor of

    Lawrence was subsequently approached by Gen. Hiraoka,

espionage among foreign firms in North China and furnishing
general information regarding their future policies.    Owing
to the unsavoury nature of the work Lawrence declined the
appointment.

    由于上述原因以及满洲国当局实施的其他加剧性限制，外国企业被迫停业，目前大连仅剩三四家航运公司在运营。局势发展到1938年，Lawrence 的生意失败，身无分文。
    6月，他前往北平，向英国大使馆详细报告了满洲国的情况。通过英国大使馆的 Hill 上尉，他试图谋求英国驻香港领事馆日语翻译的职位，但当英国当局得知他是《北平时事日报》（Peking Chronicle）编辑 George W. Goldman 先生的朋友，并曾为其撰写过一篇关于苏军在满洲国边境调动文章后，他的申请被拒绝。
    随后，华北日军司令官平冈将军（Gen. Hiraoka）接触了 Lawrence，向他提供了一份在日本军队中的职位，月薪500.00美元，外加费用报销。有人向 Lawrence 说明，其职责包括在华北的外国公司中进行间谍活动，并提供有关其未来政策的一般情报。由于工作性质令人厌恶，Lawrence 拒绝了该任命。

His subsequent efforts to obtain employment

Lawrence speaks fluent English, Japanese, Malayan,

The applicant is married; his wife resides in

He is in possession of British passport No. 367
